map.输入底数a与结果b，按 x = ln b/ln a 求解指数方程 a^x = b: Input base a and result b; solve exponent x in a^x = b by x = ln b/ln a, for logarithmic and exponential operations.
map.输入底数 a 与结果 b，求指数 x。: Input base a and result b to find exponent x.

map.核心是对数换底：x = log(b) / log(a)，与底数选取无关。: The core is base-change of logarithm: x = log(b) / log(a), independent of base choice.
map.底数 a 必须 >0 且 ≠1，真数 b 必须 >0。: Base a must be >0 and !=1, argument b must be >0.
map.：x = log(81)/log(3) = 4.0000；x = log(100: : x = log(81)/log(3) = 4.0000; x = log(1000)/log(10) = 3.0000. The base-change formula guarantees any base is computable.
map.logₐ(b) = ln(b)/ln(a) = log(b)/log(a)，即任: log_a(b) = ln(b)/ln(a) = log(b)/log(a), i.e. the ratio of two same-base logarithms. It unifies exponential equations with non-10/non-e bases into common-logarithm operations.
